reason: I'd probably download it for the free 14 days since there's no auto-charge and the auto-replay is off by default, which is what I worry about. But I already play YouTube rain sounds for free with a timer, and I've tried enough sleep apps that I expect the 14-day report to show little difference, so I doubt I'd end up paying.
objection: With my shifts changing every week, 7 nights per method is too few and too messy to tell me anything real, and I don't trust phone-on-the-mattress tracking to know when I actually fell asleep after a night shift when I'm sleeping at 9am.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day report actually showed I fell asleep clearly faster (like 10+ minutes) on the SLEEP:ON nights, I'd pay the yearly 39,000 won.
